name: authentik
summary: authentik is an identity provider with a free open-source edition that can be self-hosted. Its Enterprise edition costs $5 per workforce user per month, billed annually. It acts as a SAML provider for single sign-on, provisions users to other apps over SCIM, and decides who reaches an application with reusable policies.

facts.text: authentik's SAML provider lets it integrate with service providers using the SAML 2.0 protocol.
authentik's SCIM provider provisions and syncs users from authentik into other applications, and a removed user is deprovisioned from the target SCIM endpoint.
authentik describes policies as reusable checks that can decide whether someone reaches an application and can also control flow stages, sources and prompt validation.
The Open Source edition is free with community support through GitHub and Discord. Its pricing page lists OIDC, SAML and SCIM as included.

plans.name: Enterprise (workforce accounts)
plans.notes: Billed annually. Agent and service accounts are included

plans.name: Enterprise Plus
plans.notes: Starting at $20,000 a year, for custom contracts and dedicated support

hiddenCosts: The Open Source edition is self-hosted, so the buyer pays for servers and the staff time to run and update them.
